name: Tobiah
bio: Tobiah, an Ammonite official, was furious with Sanballat when he heard Nehemiah had come to seek Israel's welfare, and later mocked the Jews with Sanballat and Geshem the Arab as rebels against the king when they began rebuilding Jerusalem's wall. Nehemiah told them God would prosper the work and that they had no share, right, or claim in Jerusalem (Nehemiah 2:10, 19-20). His continued opposition is told in detail in the chapters ahead.
